name: video-compressor
description: Shrink a folder of videos for sharing, uploading or archiving. Pick a quality preset or a target size per file, cap the resolution, choose what to do with the sound, and see a rough size estimate before anything runs. Every video becomes an H.264 MP4 that plays everywhere and starts streaming right away; if a file wouldn't get any smaller the original is kept. A report lists the before and after sizes. Uses the free ffmpeg already installed on your computer; nothing is uploaded and no API keys are needed.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 把一整个文件夹的视频压小，方便分享、上传或存档。每个文件可以选画质方案或指定大小，限制最大分辨率，决定声音怎么处理，开始前就能看到预计大小。每个视频都会转成到处都能播放、可以边下边播的 H.264 MP4；如果压不小就保留原文件。报告里列出压缩前后的大小。使用电脑上已安装的免费 ffmpeg，不上传，无需 API 密钥。
